headline: Expanse Seesaw Rolls On; Stlican Shelf Wakes Anew
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has swung again since our last edition: the Colonial count there stands at five against two for the Wardens, with two posts now in ruin, and forty-five base actions crowd the day's ledger — Crow's Nest alone figures twenty-two times, the latest report logged forty minutes before press. Callahan's Passage keeps its eight-of-ten Warden grip but filed action to the very minute, the twenty-four-hour toll now 8,849 Colonial and 7,865 Warden and still climbing. Stlican Shelf has stirred anew: Fort Hoarfrost took the brunt, and the Warden holding there has thinned to three against five Colonial with one base razed. Mooring County shows no map movement in eleven hours, the Wardens keeping eleven of twelve, though its ledger still runs near ten thousand a side. Palantine Berm and the Nevish Line are likewise quiet on the map yet bleed freely, their casualty rates surging again over the past two hours. It is day 383; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
